lines.say: At nine fourteen, a painting vanished.

lines.text: The gallery was locked. Three people had a key.
The guard said: I watched the cameras all night.
The cleaner said: I left at nine. Ask the bus driver.
The driver remembered her. Bus 9, at 9:02.
lines.say: The driver remembered her. Bus nine, at nine-oh-two.

lines.text: The owner said: I was home. It's insured anyway.
Two million dollars. A good reason to lie.
But his doorman saw him come home at eight.
So Inspector Hale asked for the camera footage.
Rain was running down the gallery window.
But it hadn't rained in Ashford for a week.
The footage was old. Someone had looped it.
And only one person controlled the cameras.
Case closed. Did you catch the rain?
